newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN DATA DUE -Nov state CPI.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN DATA DUE -Nov state CPI.

text.p: The state statistics offices of Hesse, North-Rhein Westphalia and Bavaria said on Friday they would publish their respective November price data on Monday.
Earlier on Friday, the state of Baden-Wuerttemberg said its consumer prices were down 0.1 percent on the previous month and up 1.3 percent year-on-year.
The data was the first of the figures from the four German states which are used to calculate preliminary German inflation.
The Hesse statistics office said the state would publish inflation figures for November at 0800 GMT on Monday.
North-Rhein Westphalia plans to release its figures at 1300 GMT on that day and the Bavarian statistics said it would publish figures in the late morning.
